title: Coty appoints Kara Langan General Manager of Consumer Beauty US to ‘strengthen’ the business
summary: Langan, who most recently served as Chief Marketing Officer of Face and Skincare at Evermark, will join Coty this month, overseeing the commercial strategy and brand performance of its consumer beauty business in the US

extraction.key_fact: 코티가 미국 컨슈머 뷰티 사업 강화를 위해 카라 랑간을 총괄 관리자로 선임했다.
